name: Demonize on Date
source:
It has been awhile - a whole year, in fact! - since four friends hung out with each other, and Sidasta has a lot to say...particularly about Mothiso.

[From [url=https://zie-tales.itch.io/demonize-on-date]itch.io[/url]]

四個朋友已經有段時間沒聚在一起了——說真的，整整一年！西達斯塔攢了好多話想說……特別是關於莫西索的。
